messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions designed to help students learn about their new 先生:

1. True or False: I have traveled to another country. (Let students vote first before the 答え! This one is a crowd favorite since everyone loves guessing about real people. 2. True or 嘘: I once failed a class in school. Students will be very shocked to hear this fact ね. 3. True or False: I am a morning person who gets up early every single day 毎日. 4. True or False: I have a pet with a name starting with the letter B ね. 5. True or False: I can play a musical instrument. (Bonus points if they can guess 正しい!) 6. True or False: I used to have a different career before teaching. 7. True or 嘘: I have more than one sibling. 8. True or False: My favorite food is something sweet ね. These questions work well because they are lighthearted, easy to answer, and help break the ice 完璧. Students feel engaged when they get to guess about a real person, and the teacher shares 個性 in a low-pressure way. You can also let students write their own guesses on sticky notes 前 the reveal to build excitement. Good luck to the new teacher on their first day of 学校!

6. True or False: I used to have a different career before teaching.
7. True or False: I have more than one sibling.
8. True or False: My favorite food is something sweet.

These questions work well because they are lighthearted, easy to answer, and help break the ice. Students feel engaged when they get to guess about a real person, and the teacher gets to share personality in a low-pressure way. You can also let students write their own guesses on sticky notes before the reveal to build anticipation.

Good luck to the new teacher on their first day!"
